title: West Coast Glide
description: A west-coast style funk hip-hop groove in G minor at 95 BPM, swing 0.12: a four-bar vamp (Gm7, Gm7, Cm7, D7), a syncopated sixteenth-note funk bass with octave pops, off-beat organ stabs, light congas and a high gliding saw lead with a slapback echo. Arranged as intro, hook, verse, hook, a break without drums or bass, hook and outro (44 bars, about 1 minute 51). Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
